episodes.subject: reco-8yk: define ZZ Epic One and put the plan under version control
ADR-002: Rust workspace layout and crate boundaries (reco-a54 / e0.2)
reco-5vz: path taxonomy and noise policy engine — one table for what a path IS and how noisy it is (e0.9)
reco-cey: repository discovery and git object access via gix (e1.1)
reco-f28: incremental indexing with a tree-hash analysis cache (e1.4)
reco-j83: dependency manifest and lockfile parsers across ecosystems (e2.5)
reco-nts: episode segmentation — boundaries, identity that survives a rewrite, and the review state that rides on it (e1.3)
reco-v6t: the TUI shell — tickless loop, focus model, chord keymap, generated help (e1.5)
reco-myd: background materialisation — hunks decoded off the UI thread, bounded,
reco-279: spike s3 — what a graph-per-revision actually costs at 10k commits, measured five ways, and the snapshot policy that closed ADR-004 §14.1 (s3)
reco-6pl: test surface delta and coverage proxy — the testing contract per episode, in test names and locations, not a coverage percentage (e2.9)
reco-6hp: session state persistence and resume — quit saves the session, open gets it back, two TUIs cannot clobber each other, and a corrupt file is quarantined rather than fatal (e1.11)
reco-wzt: the TUI gets a data path — the rail lists the episodes the index holds
reco-c05: the queue ranks — the shipped TUI can answer "which three are the riskiest"
reco-afh: hooks v1 ingestion — the reader that tolerates a torn line, quarantines what it refuses, remembers its offset, and rebuilds identical turns from byte 0 (e6.1)
reco-a0v: rename and copy pairing — a fact is what git asserts at 0.75, everything else is a labelled guess a reviewer can accept or reject (e2.4)
reco-quk.3: a turn_id is <session_id>:<turn_index> on both transports — the trailer transport's bare index read two sessions' turn 3 as one episode (e1.14)
reco-tt4: one versioned delta model, and the gates that keep it the only one (e2.11)
reco-yxi: dependency risk — who asked for this, advisories with their age, and a licence matrix (e2.7)
reco-2uo: the first five minutes — a repository that ships in the binary, an estimate that converges, and no shrugs anywhere (e5.9)
